states: Same-named PBS connections and nested/root namespaces remain distinct and fully readable without hover in both existing views. Missing source connection is not inferred from guest ownership.
Node-local archive copies retain their distinct physical storage hosts and saved location scope. Verification and prune protection remain separate.
The 166-point windowed feed brings every complete source label into the actual viewport at desktop and 320px; mounting off-screen labels is insufficient. Window bounds remain 140 desktop / 36 phone.
interactions: Keyboard and touch select the existing PBS connection facet; switching to Coverage and refreshing retains that exact URL scope, open evidence and focus while an updated namespace arrives through the real HTTP reader/model. Removing the facet restores all six distinct points.

Desktop container resizing through 640/320/1365px preserves each source label once. Location sorting follows the complete visible source path. Native wheel scrolling reaches all 166 fully visible labels in Chromium desktop/phone and WebKit phone.
Only synthetic local GETs are admitted. No provider/off-origin/mutating request, page error or console error; browser and server close.
